heroHeadline: Mecca Pact Faces Its First Real Test: Pakistan's Asif Says Pact "Will" Respond After Houthi Attack Wounds 73 in Saudi Arabia
heroSubtitle: A Sep 8 Houthi missile-and-drone barrage on Aramco sites and King Khalid Air Base across southern Saudi Arabia — the first strike analysts call a genuine test of the month-old pact — drew condemnation from Turkey and Pakistan; Pakistan's Defence Minister Khawaja Asif issued the strongest activation-adjacent statement yet, saying aggression against any signatory "will" draw a joint response, while Islamabad weighs airstrikes on Houthi positions pending a formal Saudi request. No signatory has yet taken military action.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
